files.description: Item entry, participant selection, tip calculation, and live totals

files.content:
# Pixel Bill Splitter

A small offline browser app for splitting item costs among Alex, Blair, and Casey.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. No installation, server, network access, or external assets are needed.

## Use

Add an item, enter its price, and check everyone sharing it. Set the tip percentage to update each person's amount and the group total. Unchecked items are not assigned to anyone. Prices are rounded to cents; when an item's cents cannot divide evenly, leftover cents go to the selected people in displayed order. Tip is calculated on each person's accumulated share and rounded to cents.
